summary: @servicetitan/eslint-plugin-folder-schema preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/`, extracts the platform-specific `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727 KB obfuscated script `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` carries a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header and uses shift-based string-array obfuscation (`WV8StW` decoder with hex-named identifiers and an integer-only literal table) with no shipped source. The declared purpose is an ESLint plugin, and the actual ESLint rule code in `dist/index.js` is roughly 4 KB; the obfuscated Bun-only payload is unrelated to that function and executes on every `npm install`. Using an alien runtime to execute an obfuscated bundle bypasses Node-based inspection. Package metadata points at `docs.st.dev` and `github.com/servicetitan/uikit`, but the shipped preinstall behavior does not match the advertised ServiceTitan ESLint plugin, consistent with scope impersonation or a compromised publish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
